description_en: Modifies the servers that are added to a vulnerability whitelist
description_zh: 修改漏洞白名单机器列表
name: ModifyVulWhitelistTarget

parameters.help_en: The source IP address of the request
parameters.name: source_ip

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the whitelist.

You can call the [DescribeVulWhitelist](~~DescribeVulWhitelist~~) operation to query the IDs of whitelists
parameters.help_zh:
漏洞白名单ID。
您可以调用[DescribeVulWhitelist](~~DescribeVulWhitelist~~)接口获取漏洞白名单的ID
parameters.name: id

parameters.help_en:
The applicable scope of the whitelist. The value of this parameter is in the JSON format and contains the following fields:

type: the type of the applicable scope. Valid values:

    *   GroupId: the ID of a server group
    *   Uuid: the UUID of a server

uuids: the UUIDs of servers

groupIds: the IDs of server groups

If you leave this parameter empty, all servers are added to the whitelist. If you set the type field to GroupId, you must also specify the groupIds field. If you set the type field to Uuid, you must also specify the uuids field
parameters.help_zh:
设置白名单生效的范围。该字段为JSON格式，包含以下字段。
type：生效类型。取值：
    - GroupId：群组
    - Uuid：主机资产
uuids：主机资产UUID集合。
groupIds：群组编号集合。
该值为空表示作用全部主机。若type为GroupId时，groupIds不能为空。若type为Uuid时，uuids不能为空
parameters.name: target_info

parameters.help_en: The reason why you add the server to the whitelist
parameters.name: reason
